overview_description.description: MediSponsor is a healthtech and cloud-based healthcare solutions company that provides integrated healthcare CRM, payment gateway, hospital management, and digital healthcare services. The company focuses on building an XAAS (Anything-as-a-Service) healthcare ecosystem connecting patients, hospitals, clinics, students, healthcare providers, and retailers through a unified digital platform.
